# Agentic Architect · Sophia Stein
# https://llmstxt.org

> Applied AI architecture, Productive-Friction interview harnesses, 4 practitioner curricula (from non-technical foundations to bespoke APIs and private open-weight rigs), Forward Deployed builds, and Fractional CAIO / AI CTO leadership. Based in Boulder, Colorado.

Sophia Stein is an AI Systems Architect, Educator, and Advisor. Her background spans a B.S. in Computer Science from Columbia University, enterprise SaaS FinOps ($70M sales OpEx saved) and clinical AI enablement (250+ healthcare leaders trained at 79 NPS) at McKinsey & Company, and AI Systems & Enablement at Google (where she has led extensive internal AI trainings and co-invented a patent-pending AI system; all writing, teaching, and advising on this site are strictly in her personal capacity, views her own). She has trained 300+ founders and operators live at Boulder Startup Week and spoken for Women Who Code.

## Core Focus Areas

1. The 4-Curriculum AI Architecture Academy (/courses): 20 practitioner modules across (01) Foundations, 2026 Model Matrix & Productive-Friction Interview Skills ($297), (02) Department AI Systems: Vertical SaaS vs. Build In-House across Marketing, Finance, Legal & Ops ($397), (03) Bespoke Harnesses, Best-of-Breed APIs & Forward Deployed Engineering ($497), and (04) The Sovereign AI Stack: Open-Weights, 96GB-512GB Private Rigs & Tailscale ($497), plus the $997 All-Access Pass with 100% 60-day tuition credit.
2. Forward Deployed "Build-For-You" AI Systems (/work-with-me): Embedded engineering wiring bespoke multi-model routers, best-of-breed Search/OCR/Voice/Sandbox APIs, MCP servers, 25-case Golden Evals, and codified department SKILL.md repositories inside client infrastructure.
3. Fractional CAIO / AI CTO, Corporate Department Labs & Keynotes (/fractional-ai-cto, /teaching): Part-time executive AI leadership, 2-week architecture diagnostics, Half-Day ($7,500) and Full-Day ($15,000) functional trainings, and conference keynotes.
